Blob ids and sha256 of each file as read (LF, as stored): MMDevice/MMDeviceConstants.h blob e8a18b9deffc21ee88140c6b2e31fef211309fb8, sha256 d2a5e0f677a051692ecbdcd017a53b23a644cb91f5c0937833f973f7c4eaf678; MMDevice/MMDevice.h blob e79784ffcd60f0d52001bb2fdfa28eadd0845705, sha256 aea0b3bcb7efb67d80a78c01a583099025e4a36b75c4edb49c4aeb8890224607; MMCore/MMCore.cpp blob adfcbf95a4334d34f0714945fb4cf2dfa5427eaf, sha256 781770dd42034e85d6fcc5b0ee704c811463142db0450fcf0f722006537d75d2; MMCore/Devices/StageInstance.cpp blob d620f71162c0f4b00de85cbb123fc1bf99ba091b, sha256 ddfd9fd8fe60a290412d588dc3792f0b2bd0934ef5724b03c6e3e0f50a63752e.

what_it_states.link_1_file_to_core: MMCore/MMCore.cpp lines 7760-7768: a configuration line whose first token is MM::g_CFGCommand_FocusDirection (defined as "FocusDirection" at MMDevice/MMDeviceConstants.h line 211) must have exactly three tokens, else the load fails with MMERR_InvalidCFGEntry; the core then calls setFocusDirection(tokens[1], atol(tokens[2])) -- the second token is the stage label and the third is passed as an integer sign. MMCore/MMCore.cpp lines 2261-2268: setFocusDirection maps sign > 0 to MM::FocusDirectionTowardSample, sign < 0 to MM::FocusDirectionAwayFromSample, and anything else (zero) to MM::FocusDirectionUnknown; lines 2269-2280: if the label is not a focus stage, nothing is done and no error is raised ('For legacy reasons').
what_it_states.link_2_value_to_meaning: MMCore/MMCore.cpp lines 2225-2229, the documentation of getFocusDirection: 'Returns +1 if increasing position brings objective closer to sample, -1 if increasing position moves objective away from sample, or 0 if unknown.' MMDevice/MMDeviceConstants.h lines 291-295: enum FocusDirection { FocusDirectionUnknown = 0, FocusDirectionTowardSample = +1, FocusDirectionAwayFromSample = -1 }. MMDevice/MMDevice.h lines 612-624, the device interface's GetFocusDirection: 'Indicates whether increasing position corresponds to movement in the direction that brings the objective and sample closer together', and an adapter must return Unknown unless the direction is known for sure.
what_it_states.precedence: MMCore/Devices/StageInstance.cpp lines 40-61: the stage reports the adapter's own GetFocusDirection only while no direction has been set; SetFocusDirection, which the configuration line reaches through setFocusDirection, sets it and from then on that value is returned. MMCore/MMCore.cpp lines 2231-2233 and 2255-2256 say the same in prose.
what_it_states.what_the_core_does_with_it: Within MMCore at the pin the value is only stored, returned by getFocusDirection, and written back by the configuration saver (MMCore.cpp lines 7507-7508); a search of every .cpp and .h under MMCore/ found no other use, so the core itself moves nothing differently because of it. What an application above the core does with it was not searched.

version_match: Exact build commit of the instrument's 20260806 nightly was not identified; the pin is the last main commit before that date. The four pieces of logic are identical across the whole 12.5.0 span and after it: MMDeviceConstants.h's enum is the same at 8df520db (the 'MMCore 12.5.0' commit, 2026-04-21), at the pin, at c3398946 (12.5.1, 2026-10-06) and at 339e0c8f (main, 2026-10-14); StageInstance.cpp is the same blob at all four; the setFocusDirection body and the configuration branch hash the same at all four. So whichever 12.5.0 commit the build came from, the answer is the same.
not_a_source: The imported .cfg comments under microscope_agent/autofocus/configs/micromanager/ and the prior project's notes were not used (task 053). No web summary was used.
gaps_named: The Nikon Ti2 adapter (Micro-Manager library NikonTi2) has no source in mmCoreAndDevices at the pin: DeviceAdapters/ holds Nikon, NikonKs and NikonTE2000 and nothing named Ti2. So what the Ti2 adapter's ZDrive reports by itself, which is what getFocusDirection returns when a configuration has NO FocusDirection line for it, is not stated by any source read here.
